If the raw value for an integer-valued property is not an integer,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
places:
    place-with-error:
        name: Place With Error
        type: county
        properties:
            # population is an integer property.
            population: "string instead of integer"
    place-well-formed:
        name: Place Well Formed
        type: county
        properties:
            population: 9

-- want-errors --
places\[place-with-error\].Properties.population: value discarded: expected integer, got string
places\[place-with-error\].Properties.population: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
places\[place-with-error\].Properties.population: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
places:
    place-with-error:
        name: Place With Error
        type:
            definition:
                label: County
            value: county
        properties: {}
    place-well-formed:
        name: Place Well Formed
        type:
            definition:
                label: County
            value: county
        properties:
            population:
                definition:
                    label: Population
                    value_type: integer
                entries:
                -   value: IntValue{9}
